book.name: SAN LUKAS
book.title: JESUKRISTU KAY ALLPAPI KAWSASHKANTA SAN LUKAS KILLKARKAN

content: Jesus yachachikurkan chinkadu ovejapa ejemplunta.

Chaymanta Jesus yachachikushkanwasha aypa runakuna laduncharkansapa ashwanta uyarinayashpa. Suk runakuna karkansapa romano gobiernupa kullki kobrakukkuna. Sukkuna karkansapa mana allita rurashpa kawsak runakuna.

Chay aypa runakuna Jesusta ladunchaptinkuna fariseokuna Moisespa killkashkanta yachachikuk runakuna kawarkansapa. Paykunaka Jesusta washanchashpankuna rimarkansapa: —Kay runaka chay uchasapa runakunata munashpa paykunawan mikun. Paykunawan mikushpa mana allitachu ruran.
Mana allita ruraykananta rimaptinkuna Jesuska uyarirkan. Chaypina suk ejempluta willarkansapa:

—Ichara kankunapa tiyan pachak ovejaykichi. Chay pachakmanta ichara suk oveja chinkanman. Kankunaka chay aypa ovejaykichita pastupi sakishpaykichi ¿manachu chay chinkaduta rinkichi maskak tarinaykichikaman?
Tarishpaykichi kushikuypuru wantushpa wasikichiman pushankichiman.
Chaypina familyaykichita aylluykichita tantanachishpa kushikushpa willankichiman: “Shamuychi ñukawan kushikuychi. Ñami kay ovejayni chinkadutaka tarishkanina.”

Mash allita uyariwaychi. Kankuna suk chinkadu ovejaykichita tarishpaykichi sukaman kushikunkichi. Chashnami sielupi kawsakkunapish iskun chunka iskun alli rurak runakuna tiyashkanmanta ashwanta kushikunsapa suk runa uchanmanta wanaptin.
Jesus yachachikurkan chinkadu kullkipa ejemplunta.

Chaymanta Jesuska chikan ejempluta yachachikurkan: —Ichara suk warmi chunka kullkinkuna tiyapushkanmanta sukta chinkachinman. ¿Manachu chayta maskan tarinankaman? Alkusanta apichishpa wasinta kuchun mañanta pichashpa maskan.
Tarishpana kushikuyninwan warmimasinkunata tantanachishpa willanka: “Ñukawan kushikuychi. Ñami chay chinkadu kullkinitaka tarishkanina.”
Mash allita uyariwaychi. Chay warmi kullkinta tarishpa sukaman kushikurkan. Chashnashina angelkunapish sukaman kushikunsapa suk runa uchankunamanta wanaptin.
Jesus yachachikurkan tatanmanta ashudu waynapa ejemplunta.
Jesuska chikan ejempluta yachachikurkan: —Suk runapa tiyarkan ishkay ullku wambrankuna.
Suk diya winshu wambran tatantaka willarkan: “Tatayni, patumawayna tukuy ñukata kuwanaykitana.” Chashna mañaptinna chay runa tukuy tiyapunanta ishkantin wambrankunata patumarkansapa.
Chaypina chay winshu wambranka tatan tukuy kushkanta rantikurkan. Chay kullkiwan rirkan suk karu llaktapi kawsak. Chay karu llaktapina sukaman mana allikunata rurashpa tukuy kullkinta tukucharkan.
Chaypina chay kawsanan llaktapika sinchi yarkay tiyarkan. Chay wayna mana kullkiyuk kashpana yarkarkan.
Chashna sukaman yarkashpa rirkan willak suk runata trabajachinanpa. Chay patronka kacharkan chakranpi kuchinkunata karashpa trabajananpa.
Chaypina chay waynaka kuchikunapa mikunanta sukaman mikunayarkan. Munaptinpish mana ni pi ni chay laya mikunata kararkansapachu.
Sukaman yarkashpana tatanta yuyashpa rimarkan: “Tataynipa trabajadorninkunapa aypa mikunankuna puchun. Chaykamanka kaypika yarkaymanta ñuka wañunayaykani.
Shu kunanlla tatayniman kutisha. Kutishpayni willasha: ‘Munanayni tatayni, kanmanta ashushpaynika uchallikushkanimi. Chaymanta mana Tata Diospa munananta rurashpa kawsashkani.
Chayrayku amana kawawaynachu wambraykitashina. Suk trabajadornikitashina trabajachiway.’ ”

Chashna allita yuyaykushpa chay waynaka tatanman kutirkan. Tatanpa wasinpi manara chayaptinra karupi kaptinlla tatanka riksirkan. Sukaman llakichishpa kallparkan tinkuk. Chaypina wambranta abrasashpa mucharkan.
Payka tatantaka willarkan: “Munanayni tatayni, kanta sakishpayni Tata Diosta rabyachirkani kantapish rabyachishkayki. Amana kawawaynachu wambraykitashina.”

Chashna willaykaptinna tatanka trabajadorninkunata kayashpa willarkansapa: “Utkakushpa apamuychi mushuk llachapata wambraynita mudachinaykichipa. Chaymanta suk anilluta dedunpi churapuychi. Mushuk ushutantapish churachiychi.
Chaymanta rillaychi pushamuk chay ashwan gordo beshekuta. Chayta wañuchishpa fiestata rurashpa mikuypachi.
Kay wambrayni wañudu kashkanmantashina unay tiempumantanami rikurimushka. Chinkadu kashkanmanta ñami rikurimushkana.” Chashna chay runa rimaptin alli fiestata rurarkansapa.
Chay fiestata ruraykaptinkuna chay mayor wambranka chakranpi karkan. Chakranmanta kutimuykashpa wasinpi chayaykashpa bombota kenata uyarirkan fiestata ruraykaptinkuna.
Fiestakuykaptinkuna uyarishpana tatanpa trabajadorninta kayashpa tapurkan: “¿Imatatí ruraykansapa tataynipa wasinpi?”

Chaypina chay runaka willarkan: “Chay chinkadu wawkikika ñami rikurimushkana. Chayrayku tataykika kushikuyninwan alli fiestata ruraykan. Wawkiki sanu chayamushka kaptin ashwan gordo beshekuta wañuchichishka.”
Chashna willaptinna chay mayor wambranka sukaman piñakurkan. Mana nima chay fiesta wasipi yaykunayarkanchu. Fiesta wasimanta tatanka llukshishpa rirkan willak paywan fiestakuk yaykunanpa.

Chaypina chay wayna piñakushpa tatantaka willarkan: “Kanka allita yachanki aypa watatana mana ni mayman suchushpayni kanta yanapashkaynita. Chashna allita yanapaptinipish mana niman suk kuti niman suk chivuta kuwashkankichu amiguynikunawan fiestata rurashpa mikunaynikunapa.
Kunan waynandera warmikunawan uchallikushpa kullkikita tukuchak wambrayki chayamushkana. Chayamuptin paypana chay ashwan gordo beshekuta wañuchishpa alli fiestata ruraykanki.”
Chashna chay mayor wambran piñakushpa willaptinna tatanka willarkan: “Munanayni wambrayni, kanka tukuy diyami ñukawan kawsaykanki. Tukuy laya tiyawakmi kanpa kanan tiyan.

Chaykuna kanpa kaptin ¿imapatí piñayawanki? Kay wawkikika wañudu kashkanmantashina rikurimushka. Chinkadu kashkanmanta ñami rikurimushkana. Chayrayku alli kashka fiestata rurananchipa. Akuychi kushikushpa fiestakuypachi.”
